title.en: A local orientation around a Moebius band

summary: Follow a local frame around a half-twisted ribbon and inspect the reversed seam identification.
objective: Build a Moebius band with a centerline traveler, local normal marker and a trace of its single boundary.
intent_signals: Build a Moebius band with a centerline traveler, local normal marker and a trace of its single boundary.
Follow a local frame around a half-twisted ribbon and inspect the reversed seam identification.
example_prompts: Build a Moebius band with a centerline traveler, local normal marker and a trace of its single boundary.
Create an explorable 3D explanation of Mobius strip with boundary trace.
negative_signals: A thick manufactured ribbon has an ordinary solid boundary; it is not identical to the zero-thickness mathematical band.
not_for: A thick manufactured ribbon has an ordinary solid boundary; it is not identical to the zero-thickness mathematical band.

entities.name: Half-twisted ribbon
entities.guidance: Build an indexed strip with reversed endpoint indexing at the seam; keep the mathematical surface zero-thickness and any rim thickness explicitly decorative.

entities.name: Local frame marker
entities.guidance: Attach a short normal arrow and asymmetric orientation glyph to the centerline using derivatives; compare it with a saved starting marker after one loop.

entities.name: Boundary trace
entities.guidance: Draw one continuous highlighted boundary path requiring two parameter circuits; distinguish the boundary route from the centerline route.

state_contract.authority: The parameter point, seam identification and local derivative frame own traversal; a surface normal is local and cannot be assigned globally consistently.
actions: Advance centerline traversal through one or two circuits.
Toggle the boundary trace and local frame.

invariants: One centerline circuit returns to the same location with reversed local normal; two restore it.
The parameter seam matches opposite width coordinates without a geometric crack.
Boundary tracing returns to its starting point after covering both parameter edges.
motion_guidance: Transport the local frame continuously rather than reorienting it toward the camera.
No physical strip twisting process is claimed by moving a marker on an already constructed surface.
known_limits: A thick manufactured ribbon has an ordinary solid boundary; it is not identical to the zero-thickness mathematical band.
Animation illustrates the declared construction and is not a proof of general nonorientability or a cutting simulation.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: The Moebius band is nonorientable and has a single boundary component.
claims.scope: Mathematical band surface; thick visual edging is only presentation.

object_craft.structure: Build an indexed strip with reversed endpoint indexing at the seam; keep the mathematical surface zero-thickness and any rim thickness explicitly decorative.
object_craft.material: Double-sided matte ribbon, distinct boundary stroke and asymmetric printed frame glyph; do not imply two global sides using permanent side colors.
